title: What if you fell into a black hole?
lines: What would actually happen if you fell into a black hole?
Black holes form when a giant star collapses, squeezing more mass than our Sun into a ball just a few dozen miles wide.
Its gravity is so strong that past a boundary called the event horizon, not even light can escape.
Now imagine you're falling in. To a friend watching from far away, you'd seem to slow down...
grow dimmer and redder, and appear to freeze at the edge, never quite crossing.
But for you, time feels completely normal. You'd drift across the horizon without noticing a thing.
That is, if the black hole is a giant one. Near a small one, gravity pulls on your feet far harder than on your head.
You'd be stretched thinner and thinner, like a noodle. Scientists really call this spaghettification.
And once inside, every path leads to one place: the singularity, where the laws of physics as we know them break down.
